name: CMDReader
author: Chai Chaimee
description: Automatically reads new output in Command Prompt, PowerShell, and Windows Terminal in real-time. Features instant audio notifications for terminal states and errors, customizable error keywords, a dedicated NVDA settings panel for privacy management, and live session shadow history scrolling without disrupting your workflow. Hot Keys: CTRLALT+L : Open CMDReader File ctrl+alt+up arrow : Read the previous line ctrl+alt+down arrow : Read the next line
